A critical component of this role is building and sustaining a high-performing team with expertise across IT disciplines. The director will evaluate team capabilities, enhance productivity, and support professional development, fostering a collaborative and engaged work environment. This leader champions shared governance, ensuring co-created departmental standards and best practices that align with Samaritan Health’s strategic goals. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information resource management, business, or equivalent is required. These improvements have resulted in a virtually new facility featuring single-bed rooms, a completely new Intensive Care Unit, a new Mother and Baby Center, a new cafeteria, a lobby, and expanded patient and family waiting areas. Samaritan Healthcare has been rated by CMS a 4-star accredited hospital and is a founding member of the Grand Columbia Health Alliance. The Community One of the fastest growing areas in Washington, Moses Lake and the surrounding area including the City of Warden offers a variety of affordable housing from new suburban-style developments to family farms. Known as the Desert Oasis, Moses Lake and the surrounding area of Grant County is located in the heart of the Columbia Basin in Central Washington. With a Service Area Population of 54,000 people, livable is best way to describe the community.
